subject: City Ambassador Kickoff — PO and inventory fund release
messages:
From: Beth Hwang <beth@localarts.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: City Ambassador Kickoff — vendor kit invoice and PO needed

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for having Local Arts Collective partner on the City Ambassador kickoff on Oct 20. BrightKit (our logistics + kit vendor) sent an initial invoice for the welcome kits and shipping that they need attached to a PO before they can ship.

Quick details:
- Vendor: BrightKit Co. (Jesse Long)
- Line items: 250 ambassador kits (stickers, lanyards, welcome card), fulfillment + express shipping
- Quote total: $9,600 (BrightKit_quote_09-28.pdf attached)

Can you confirm whether Redwood will issue a PO or if we should accept a vendor invoice for payment? If you need a cost center or an advance, let me know and I can loop in finance.

Happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

—Beth
Beth Hwang
Programs Director, Local Arts Collective
beth@localarts.org

Attachment: BrightKit_quote_09-28.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Beth Hwang <beth@localarts.org>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: City Ambassador Kickoff — vendor kit invoice and PO needed

Thanks Beth — looping finance and events ops to get a PO in place.

Laura / Tessa / Karthik, can we get a PO for BrightKit for $9,600 and an advance release for the kits? We anticipate shipping within 5 business days once PO is accepted.

Details for PO:
- Vendor: BrightKit Co. (ops@brightkit.co)
- Total: $9,600 (quote attached)
- Purpose: City Ambassador kickoff kits (Oct 20)
- Cost center: please advise — we usually code events kit spend to 4300-ENG-Field, but let me know if you prefer a program code.
- Billing contact: Jesse Long <jesse@brightkit.co>

Attachments: BrightKit_quote_09-28.pdf (forwarded)

If you need an internal estimate, I have an estimated budget workbook — attaching now.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Events Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachment: estimated-kickoff-budget-2026-10-01.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T13:25:00-07:00
Subject: RE: City Ambassador Kickoff — vendor kit invoice and PO needed

Marissa — thanks for the details. A few items before we can issue PO / advance:

1) Confirm final spend cap: is $9,600 the committed amount or is there a contingency buffer we should include (shipping can vary)?
2) Cost center: confirm whether to use 4300-ENG-Field or 4200-MKT-Programs. If this is tied to a partner program budget, use 4200-MKT-Programs.
3) Billing terms: vendor requires PO prior to shipment — do they accept Net 30 after PO? If vendor needs upfront payment, we'll need an advance request form.

Please reply with the answers and attach the vendor W9 if you have it. I can create the PO once the cost center and final total are confirmed.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Beth Hwang <beth@localarts.org>
Date: 2026-10-01T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: City Ambassador Kickoff — vendor kit invoice and PO needed

Laura — thanks. Answers below: 

1) Final spend: $9,600 committed. Please include a 5% contingency: $480. Total authorized = $10,080. We need the PO for the $9,600 line items and an internal note that up to $10,080 is available for last-mile shipping/labeling.
2) Cost center: please code to 4200-MKT-Programs — this is part of our community activation budget.
3) Billing terms: BrightKit confirmed they will accept PO and Net 30. Beth, can you share the vendor W9 when you have it?

Attached is an updated budget estimate with the contingency column highlighted.

We'd like the PO created today if possible so Jesse can schedule fulfillment Monday.

—Marissa
Attachment: estimated-kickoff-budget-2026-10-01.xlsx (updated)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: RE: City Ambassador Kickoff — vendor kit invoice and PO needed

All good — creating PO now. PO # REDWOOD-2026-4537 created for $9,600 (line items) with internal note for contingency up to $10,080. Cost center 4200-MKT-Programs applied. Vendor payment terms set to Net 30.

Next steps for events team:
- Beth / Jesse: please send vendor W9 and remit instructions to finance (laura_bennett@redwood.com).
- Ops: ship after vendor confirms PO acceptance.
- Marissa: route actual invoices and proof of delivery to finance for final payment and any advance reconciliation.

Attaching the PO stub.

—Laura
Attachment: PO-REDWOOD-2026-4537.pdf
